FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.rtype = 'SAT'
AND s.AvgScrRead > 1500
AND s.AvgScrMath > 1500
AND s.AvgScrWrite > 1500
AND s.cds = (
    SELECT sc.CDSCode
    FROM satscores sc2
    JOIN schools sc2 ON sc2.cds = sc2.CDSCode
    WHERE sc2.rtype = 'SAT'
    AND sc2.AvgScrRead > 1500
    AND sc2.AvgScrMath > 1500
    AND sc2.AvgScrWrite > 1500
    AND sc2.cds = (
        SELECT sc3.CDSCode
        FROM satscores sc3
        JOIN schools sc3 ON sc3.cds = sc3.CDSCode
        WHERE sc3.rtype = 'SAT'
        AND sc3.AvgScrRead > 1500
        AND sc3.AvgScrMath > 1500
        AND sc3.AvgScrWrite > 1500
    )
);

    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COUNT(t.trans_id) AS withdrawal_count,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawal_amount
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawal_amount DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    t1.team_short_name AS home_team_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_matches
FROM Match m
JOIN Team t1 ON m.home_team_api_id = t1.team_api_id
JOIN Team t2 ON m.away_team_api_id = t2.team_api_id
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE l.name = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY m.id, t1.team_short_name
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM Match m2
    JOIN Team t3 ON m2.home_team_api_id = t3.team_api_id
    JOIN Team t4 ON m2.away_team_api_id = t4.team_api_id
    JOIN League l2 ON m2.league_id = l2.id
    JOIN Country c2 ON l2.country_id = c2.id
    WHERE l2.name = '2015/2016'
    AND m2.home_team_api_id = t3.team_api_id
    AND m2.away_team_api_id = t4.team_api_id
    AND l2.country_id = c2.id
    AND (m2.home_team_goal - m2.away_team_goal) < 0
)
ORDER BY total_matches ASC;

LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM "Team" t
JOIN "Team_Attributes" ta ON t.team_fifa_api_id = ta.team_fifa_api_id
JOIN "League" l ON l.id = ta.league_id
JOIN "Country" c ON c.id = l.country_id
WHERE ta.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND ta.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND ta.date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'

  AND (ta.chanceCreationPassing < (SELECT SUM(chanceCreationPassing) / COUNT(*) FROM "Team_Attributes" ta3 WHERE ta3.team_fifa_api_id = t.team_fifa_api_id))
ORDER BY ta.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

    e.Diagnosis AS Youngest_Patient_Diagnosis,
    e.`Examination Date` AS Youngest_Patient_Examination_Date
FROM
    Examination e
JOIN
    Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE
    e.Examination_Date = (
        SELECT MIN(e2.`Examination Date`)
        FROM Examination e2
        JOIN Patient p2 ON e2.ID = p2.ID
        WHERE p2.Description = p.Description
    )
    AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    e.Examination_Date ASC;
